Reported behavior/issue:
Both outlets on dispenser out of order.
Both show this.
DC3_CableTempSensor_XD230 VIV:0 RNE:1 KON:1
DC4_CableTempSensor_XD240 VIV:0 RNE:1 KON:1
We have measured the values both on XD211/XD212 and on KF214 and the are correct but in Ecog portal the show wrong values.
We have also checked for bad connections but can't find any.
The KF211 is not showing any lights on the leds but we are able to connect to it.
